mentions.heading: Conflict minerals disclosure and sourcing requirements
mentions.detail: SEC Dodd-Frank conflict minerals rules on DRC-sourced minerals; annual Form SD since 2014; customers may disqualify supplier, inventory write-offs
mentions.quote: If we are unable to meet customer requirements, customers may disqualify us as a supplier, resulting in a permanent or temporary loss of sales to such customer or a reduction in purchases from us, and we may have to write off inventory if it cannot be sold.

drivers.name: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act

mentions.heading: Failure to meet ESG expectations could adversely affect business
mentions.detail: Stopped sales to Russia and Belarus in March 2022, but Russian entities still indirectly obtained products
mentions.quote: However, we have been made aware that there are entities in Russia that indirectly obtained our products after March 2022 despite the preventative measures we took and continue to take.

mentions.heading: Failure to meet ESG expectations could adversely affect business
mentions.detail: California climate disclosure rules and EU CSRD; net zero and renewable energy goals expose company to scrutiny
mentions.quote: In addition, we are or expect to become subject to various new or proposed climate-related and other sustainability laws and regulations, including, for example, the state of California's new climate change disclosure requirements and the EU's Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive.
